verdict.rationale: LM Studio has built-in document RAG: users attach their own documents to a chat and ask a local model questions about them offline, so it can produce AI answers from user data inside the app. This is user-initiated Q&A over attached files, not proactive insight generation or suggestions surfaced from the user's data. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insights and suggestions, analysis of structured data or datasets beyond attached documents, and hands-on corroboration of RAG answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline, also known as "RAG".
LM Studio 0.3.0 comes with built-in functionality to provide a set of document to an LLM and ask questions about them.
